name: Process: Run the flag read after every non-negotiable flag and write the line
text_content:
P24, P25, with I5, I6, and rows 176 and 177. Every flag reaches both leads the same day; the read is held by both leads off the floor no later than the person's next service and writes one of three states jointly on the flag's record; "cannot read" goes to the partners' review that week; a process-failure state returns to the capture path with the reason and leaves no trace on any record about the person; the person hears the flag from their check-in's holder with the other lead present before anything is written; a line is written jointly in the closed form and read back; flags and reads are counted per period at the leads' review as counts only; where a lead is the subject the read is held by the other lead with a founder and the decision is the founders'. Extends 86akht39y, 86akhb2jg, and 17tn048qck9 by reference. Urgent.
